_comment: Every tunable number. Claude Code must NOT hard-code any of these. These values are simulated, not guessed: docs/BALANCE-PROJECTION.md is regenerated from src/domain/balance-projection.js and src/domain/balance.projection.test.js fails if a change here breaks the projection.

levelCurve._comment: xpForLevel(n) = base * n^exponent, the cumulative XP to stand at level n. Derived by simulation, not guessed: base is one honest first session, and the exponent places level 9 at a year of 4x/week training. See docs/BALANCE-PROJECTION.md.

might._comment: Volume is the base signal. Compound counts fully, isolation reduced. Soft cap stops junk volume outscoring hard work.

session._comment: What counts as one visit to the gym. A session record spans the whole day under the micro-set model, so duration is measured as time under load rather than wall-clock. See docs/11 F1 and src/domain/duration.js.

vitality._bodyMetricsNote: Awarded for the act of logging only. The recorded value must never influence XP in any direction.

rank._comment: Total of the five attribute levels maps to a rank letter.

battle._comment: Coefficients turning attributes into combat stats. Target ~80% clear rate.

progressionDefaults._comment: Progression is a PROPOSAL, never applied automatically. See docs/05: the app proposes, never imposes.

fiveThreeOne._comment: Wendler 5/3/1. Working weights are percentages of a training max, which is itself a percentage of the estimated 1RM. Week 4 is a deload.
